disclaimer: Non-normative companion to docs/specs/active-player-detection-v0-source-boundary.md. Illustrative field/enum shape only. This file does NOT validate data, does NOT authorize implementation, and asserts NO real player's current active status.

enum_decision.choice: Option B (distinct active_status detection enum) with disciplined reuse of player_ownership_v0.ownership_status as a separate field
enum_decision.rationale: ownership_status cannot express gameday-inactive, and traded/released are transaction-event concepts, not ownership states; a distinct axis avoids overloading governed values while a verbatim-reused ownership_status field avoids enum drift.

two_axes.active_status_axis: new, scoped only to availability/detection semantics

enum_decision.hard_rule: active_status and ownership_status are validated independently; a value valid in one enum is invalid in the other; no silent cross-emission.

active_status_to_ownership_status_mappin.note: no governed value for gameday-inactive; carried only in active_status; needs separate roster-status field or ownership-contract extension before it can round-trip
approximate; release is a transaction, free_agent is resulting ownership state; do not collapse without source_ref
not an ownership status; model as player_ownership_change_event_v0.event_type=team_change/trade

as_of.note: instant the active-status claim is asserted valid for

in_boundary.note: all rows active_roster_status=unknown; membership is not availability

cannot_provide: current roster truth for all players
in_boundary.note: 27-player provisional/stale subset; usable only as a stale snapshot for the ownership axis

fail_closed_rules: missing status becomes unknown, never active
missing rows are not proof of inactivity
stale snapshots cannot be treated as current truth
source-backed membership is not active status
traded/released must not collapse into current availability without source_refs
fixtures and smoke-test subsets cannot authorize current active status
current active status requires an explicit as-of source boundary that passed provenance review
fail_closed_reason required when active_status=unknown or status_basis=unavailable_unknown
active_status and ownership_status validated independently; cross-enum values invalid
forecast_consumer_guidance: Forecast must not consume active_player_detection_v0 until a real artifact exists and passes a separate coverage/provenance gate
a spec is not a dataset
a roster-membership row is not an availability feature
unknown must remain unknown, not zero or inactive
gameday-inactive/IR/traded/released/free-agent semantics stay separate unless explicitly mapped
